reviews.text: Working with Kevin from Walker Custom Exteriors to repair my old style deck after major storm damage was a breeze. Working with the insurance adjuster was not. But Kevin was professional and persistent and helped smooth that process too. Kevin’s crew did a beautiful job of seamlessly tying in the new sections of deck with the old. The end result is beautiful. I’d hire them again and would recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Charlotte Turner

reviews.text: OMG - Blown away with Kevin’s work, professionalism, and ability to not only finish my outdoor remodel on budget but ahead of schedule.  I not only recommend him to my friends but can also say he has restored my faith in contractors in general.
reviews.author: Vicci Thompson

reviews.text:
Kevin and his team did an excellent job selecting plants that would work well in my front flowerbeds.

I would not hesitate to recommend Kevin for any of your exterior projects.
reviews.author: Brian Blair

reviews.text:
Kevin has completed a touch job.  I could not find anyone willing to replace the rotted wood on my fence and build a new gate.

Kevin built a new gate from scratch and stained my fence in and out.  It looks super nice.

He did what he was contracted to do and was on time every day!

It turned out so nice, we are very pleased.
reviews.author: Douglas Molny

reviews.text: Love my yard - my deck and pergola.  Very easy to work with. Sticks to his budget and timeline.  Very pleased, highly recommend.
reviews.author: Dallas Texas

reviews.text: Kevin went above and beyond for us! New fence and patio. It’s truly chef’s kiss!
reviews.author: Melinda Fritz

reviews.text: I have used Walker Custom Exteriors for a number of outdoor projects including fence repair and staining, construction of a pergola with metal covering, creation of a hard scape feature at front of my house and creation of new and fresh landscaping. Every project has been a job well done! Kevin is very easy to work with and engages in open discussions of ideas. I would highly recommend his company and will call on him in the future for more projects!
reviews.author: Faye Britton

reviews.text: Sturdy, Well-Built Fence and great communication through out the entire process! Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Austin Perry

reviews.text: Look no further, Kevin's work is absolutely fantastic. Don't bother with big company jobs, and don't just get anyone you find to work on your fence. There is actually a lot of technical work involved, and Kevin does not cut corners. He took the time to make sure the foundation for the fence was all clear before building. He was very fast, had his crew onsite and demo'd as scheduled. High quality, professional work. He has integrity and will stick to his word, and does real professional work.
reviews.author: Yousef Mohammed

reviews.text: We used Wlaker Custom Exteriors to update our old fence and pergola behind our house. They reused most of our old fence wooden posts and pickets putting in new galvanized steel posts between the existing wooden posts. In the process they straightened the fence and replaced bad pickets and posts as needed. They also replaced a few pergola planks that needed to be replaced. We had them power wash and stained the fence and pergola to our selected color to closely match the trim on our home.
reviews.author: Ray Jan Worthington

reviews.text: Very impressed. We reached out to Walker from a recommendation of a neighbor based on their positive experience & quality of the fencing. Our initial fence company installed our fence poorly so the gate didn't open & the rain streamed out of the yard taking out two bushes. Walker evaluated the fence and yard asking questions then offered a couple of suggestions. Not only did he correct the fence bottom plank issues but he redesigned a portion of the fence so we could easily reach a faucet. I'm only bummed that we didn't call him first. There were designs we could have put in place that our initial fence company wasn't possible.
reviews.author: Rebecca Wolf

reviews.text: Kevin and his crew did a wonderful job completing an unfinished wood fence for me.  They matched the existing fence perfectly and were very fast. Would recommend to others needing fence work.
reviews.author: Julie Norkett

reviews.text: Walker Custom Exteriors built our backyard pergola. We LOVE it! It was a very quick and easy process to work with this company. They are responsive and know what they are doing! I would definitely recommend Walker Custom Exteriors for any exterior needs!
reviews.author: Katie Jordan

reviews.text: I used walker custom exteriors to cover my pergola. Loved the work, very patient and easy to keep in touch with.  Pluse great work. Ill definitely use them again for future projects
reviews.author: Marcus Ray

reviews.text: Did a great job on redoing stone walkway with flagstones, created additional flagstone walkways and additional patio area. Professional, hard worker, continued on the projects until completed. Good “can do” attitude!!
reviews.author: Roy Vandiver

reviews.text: Walker Custom Exteriors is awesome!  Kevin does great work for a good price.  Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Kevin came out to update our out of date fence. He was professional, on time & provided quality work. Highly recommend!!
